clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sludge Fen, the Venture Company’s machinery waits with its valves shut and its pressure relieved. Tinkerer Sniggles holds the key to open the control unit and free the samophlange within.

You have relieved the pressure by turning the auxiliary valves, and the dials and gauges have settled. The housing remains locked against tampering. Its key rests with the goblin engineer overseeing the drilling site.

Tinkerer Sniggles oversees the Venture Company’s equipment at the Sludge Fen. He keeps the console key in a hut just northeast of the main rig. You need that key to open the housing and reach the samophlange.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
